cards.name: Maybank 2 Gold
cards.note: Cashback and TreatsPoints. Earn rates were not rewritten in the January 2026 terms update; refunds and reversals were.

cards.name: Maybank Islamic Ikhwan American Express
cards.note: The Ikhwan Gold page publishes an air-miles conversion that names Maybank American Express, Mastercard, and Visa Gold & Platinum.

cards.name: CIMB PETRONAS Visa Infinite
cards.note: Sits on CIMB Bonus Points and the bank-wide cardholder terms, not the Preferred Visa Infinite campaign.

cards.name: CIMB e Credit Card
cards.note: Principal annual fee is RM80 from 1 January 2026. 2026 is a full waiver with no spend; 2027 needs RM6,000.

cards.name: CIMB Travel Platinum
cards.note: Covered by the bank-wide cardholder terms and the Member Rewards airline list. No separate points-rate rewrite was in this library.

cards.name: CIMB Travel World
cards.note: The 1 October 2026 Travel Card terms restate the principal annual fee at RM554.72, with later-year waiver tiers at RM120,000 (100%) and RM60,000 (50%). That document is a restatement, not a marked before/after.

cards.name: Hong Leong Visa Infinite
cards.note: Enrich earn rates were rebuilt by category on 22 May 2025. Annual fee stayed free for life.

cards.name: OCBC Titanium Mastercard Blue
cards.note: Rewards moved off the old cashback bands onto OCBC$ on 20 October 2024. The product page still waives the first-year RM75 fee through 31 December 2026; later years need RM20,000 retail spend.

cards.name: AmBank Visa Infinite
cards.note: Enrich conversion moved from 10,000 to 12,000 AmBonus Points per 1,000 Enrich Points on 1 April 2026. Conventional cash advance became 1.3% plus SST on 1 July 2026.

cards.name: AmBank Islamic Visa Infinite
cards.note: Same Enrich conversion as the conventional Visa Infinite. Islamic cash advance became a flat RM16 plus SST on 1 July 2026, up from RM12 plus SST.

cards.name: HSBC Amanah MPower Platinum
cards.note: Shariah contract moved to Tawarruq on 9 December 2025. Annual-fee waiver is now RM6,000 a year, not the old RM2,000 plus a monthly spend. Cashback categories were rewritten from 1 October 2026.

cards.name: Alliance Bank Virtual Visa
cards.note: If this is the Visa Platinum Virtual, Alliance left its earn rates alone on 1 August 2025. Bank-wide, TBP now expires after three years (pre-Dec 2025 points expire 30 November 2028). The cardholder agreement was revised from 1 December 2025.

cards.name: Affin DUO
cards.note: Grouped with DUO+ on the April 2025 airmiles conversion. The January 2026 generic terms use DUO Visa as the cashback rounding example.

cards.name: Affin DUO+
cards.note: DUO+ Visa cashback is for contactless retail of RM250 and below. Splitting a larger bill into smaller taps can be reversed.

cards.name: AEON Biker Infinite Visa
cards.note: Launched 17 June 2025. The product page still lists 8% cashback on motorcycle parts, merchandise and motor services, 8% on overseas spend, 2% on petrol and insurance, and 8 Plaza Premium visits. No later revision was on the public pages checked for this library.

notices.title: Flying Blue leaves CIMB Member Rewards on 11 October 2026
notices.summary: On the Bonus Points redemption page, CIMB says Air France-KLM Flying Blue stops as an airmiles partner on 11 October 2026. Redemptions need to be in by 10 October 2026. Bonus Points stay usable with the other airline partners.

notices.title: Cardholder terms amended from 16 October 2026
notices.summary: Notice dated 25 September 2026. CIMB Bank and CIMB Islamic cardholder terms change on 16 October 2026. The notice says the clause edits are in tables on that page. This desk does not restate clauses it could not read off the page — open the notice itself.

notices.title: MPower Platinum cashback rules rewritten from 1 October 2026
notices.summary: Notice dated 28 September 2026. eWallet top-up no longer includes Samsung Pay; Samsung Pay is now a payment-authorisation channel, and petrol or groceries paid that way count as eWallet. Giant groceries now include GHC Retail. Exclusions are split into base cashback and bonus cashback. A transaction dated in one month but posted after the 7th of the next month counts in the posting month. On a card instalment, only the original purchase counts toward eligible spend — later instalments do not.

changes.label: eWallet top-up
changes.before: Samsung Pay, GrabPay, Touch ’n Go, FavePay
changes.after: GrabPay, Touch ’n Go, FavePay. Samsung Pay is payment authorisation only

changes.label: Groceries
changes.after: Giant including GHC Retail, Lotus’s, AEON BiG, Mydin

changes.label: Posting cut-off
changes.after: Posted after the 7th of the next month counts in the posting month

notices.sourceLabel: HSBC Amanah MPower Platinum notice, 28 September 2026

notices.title: CIMB e Credit Card annual fee cut to RM80
notices.summary: From 1 January 2026 the principal annual fee is RM80, down from RM100. New and existing principal cardholders get a full waiver for 2026 with no spend. From 1 January 2027 the waiver needs RM6,000 total annual spend. Redeeming the fee with Bonus Points drops to 40,000 points for the full RM80, or 20,000 for half.

changes.label: Waiver in 2026
changes.after: Full waiver, no spend, through 31 December 2026

notices.title: Visa Infinite Enrich conversion needs 12,000 AmBonus Points
notices.summary: Notice dated 2 March 2026. The old rewards catalogue closed on 31 March 2026. From 1 April 2026 both AmBank Visa Infinite and AmBank Islamic Visa Infinite need 12,000 AmBonus Points for 1,000 Enrich Points, up from 10,000. The same notice moves World Mastercard from 12,000 to 18,000 and several Platinum, Signature and Gold cards from 15,000 to 18,000.

changes.label: Visa Infinite and Islamic Visa Infinite

notices.title: Credit card fees revised from 1 July 2026
notices.summary: Portfolio notice. Excess-limit and replacement fees fell. A printed statement doubled. Conventional cards, including Visa Infinite, moved to a 1.3% cash-advance fee plus SST, with no RM50 minimum. Islamic cards, including Islamic Visa Infinite, moved to a flat RM16 plus SST, up from RM12. Visa Infinite was not in the annual-fee table, which cut fees on BonusLink Platinum, M-Card and a UnionPay supplementary.

changes.label: Printed statement
changes.after: RM24 + SST a year. eStatement stays free

notices.title: Visa Infinite Enrich rates rebuilt by category
notices.summary: Notice dated 30 April 2025, in force 22 May 2025, for Visa Infinite and Infinite Doctor’s Edition (Infinite P has its own table). The old flat rate was RM3.50 local and RM2.20 overseas per Enrich Point. Dining improved. Travel, retail and everything else got worse, and overseas no longer earns faster than local. Annual fee stayed free for life. Government, JomPay, FPX, HLB Connect QR, cash advance, quasi-cash, Quick Cash, flexi plans, balance transfer, DuitNow AutoDebit, and fees do not earn.

changes.label: Overseas, all retail
changes.after: Same rate as local, by category

notices.title: MPower Platinum fee waiver is now RM6,000 a year
notices.summary: From 1 September 2025 the MPower Platinum waiver no longer needs a monthly transaction. It needs RM6,000 retail spend a year. The fee itself did not change. If the anniversary fell in September–December 2025, the old rule still applied that year and the new one starts September 2026. January–August 2026 anniversaries were prorated from 1 October 2025 (RM500 per month counted). From September 2026 everyone is on the full RM6,000. Cash advances, most instalments, fees, disputes and taxes do not count. HSBC says it SMSes you if the fee is waived.

changes.label: Waiver
changes.before: RM2,000 a year, and at least one spend in each of 12 straight months
changes.after: RM6,000 a year. No monthly-swipe rule

changes.label: 2026 anniversary, Jan–Aug
changes.after: Prorated RM6,000 from 1 October 2025 to the anniversary month

notices.title: MPower Platinum cash advance is RM8.70 a transaction
notices.summary: Notice dated 6 February 2026. For MPower Platinum the previous charge was RM50 per RM1,000 advanced, and that charge was waived until 1 March 2026. The revised column on the same notice is a single figure, RM8.70 per transaction, set beside both the HSBC Bank list and the HSBC Amanah list.

changes.label: Cash advance
changes.before: RM50 per RM1,000, waived until 1 March 2026

notices.title: MPower Platinum contract moved from Ujrah to Tawarruq
notices.summary: HSBC Amanah changed the Shariah contract on MPower Platinum, MPower, and Premier World Mastercard from Ujrah to Tawarruq (commodity murabahah) on 9 December 2025. The opt-out window — SMS OPTOUT1 and a full settlement by 3 December 2025 — has closed. The FAQ is the plain-language note; the customer notice is the formal one.

notices.title: Daily contactless limit raised to RM2,500
notices.summary: From 1 May 2026 the daily contactless limit on HSBC and HSBC Amanah credit cards, for purchases above RM250, moved from RM1,500 to RM2,500. Each contactless transaction still cannot exceed RM2,500. Above the daily limit you need the physical card, chip and PIN. The notice says no action is required.

notices.title: DUO+ cashback capped at RM250 a tap, and rounding is cut off
notices.summary: Posted 9 January 2026 and in force 21 days later. DUO+ Visa cashback is for contactless retail of RM250 and below. Affin can withhold or reverse cashback if you split a bill at the same merchant to stay under that cap. Cashback is calculated per transaction to two decimal places with no rounding — the notice uses Affin DUO Visa as the illustration, so both DUO and DUO+ are in the generic terms. Cards other than Business Platinum are personal use only.

changes.label: DUO+ Visa cashback
changes.after: Contactless retail of RM250 and below. Split bills can be reversed

changes.label: Rounding
changes.after: Two decimals, no round up or down. RM600.70 at 3% credits RM18.02

notices.title: DUO and DUO+ airmiles conversion worsened on 1 April 2025
notices.summary: Affin’s FAQ groups DUO and DUO+ with Avance, MPN and several other cards. For that group the rate from 1 April 2025 is 20,000 Affin Rewards Points for 1,000 Enrich, 1,000 AirAsia, or 10 Batik Air points. The FAQ lists the earlier Enrich rate for the group as 14,000 points, and 12,000 points for 1,000 AirAsia or 10 Batik Air points. Invikta and World cards are separate rows. Open the FAQ before you transfer.

changes.label: AirAsia / Batik, same group
changes.before: 12,000 points = 1,000 AirAsia, or 10 Batik Air points

notices.title: Titanium Blue left cashback and moved to OCBC$
notices.summary: Notice dated 25 September 2024, in force 20 October 2024, for Titanium Mastercard Blue and Pink. The old online cashback bands (including 7% on a thin slice of e-wallet spend) were replaced by OCBC$. The live product page adds a 20,000 OCBC$ cap per statement cycle on the accelerated rate, then unlimited 1x, and a five-year expiry.

changes.label: Online & e-wallet, up to RM1,000
changes.after: 12x OCBC$ on Double Date and Pay Day; 6x on other days

changes.label: Online & e-wallet, RM1,000–1,500
changes.after: Same OCBC$ rates, then 1x after the cycle cap

changes.label: Principal annual fee
changes.after: RM75. First year waived through 31 December 2026 on the product page; later years need RM20,000

notices.title: OCBC daily contactless limit is RM3,000
notices.summary: Notice dated 8 July 2026. From 3 August 2026 every OCBC credit card, including Titanium Blue, has a daily cumulative contactless limit of RM3,000, up from RM1,000. A single contactless charge without PIN is still capped at RM250. You can set the daily limit from RM1,000 to RM5,000 via the contact centre or a branch. A PIN transaction refreshes the cumulative limit.

changes.label: Daily cumulative contactless
changes.after: RM3,000 default. Choosable from RM1,000 to RM5,000

notices.title: Maybank 2 Gold can claw back cashback and TreatsPoints on a refund
notices.summary: RinggitPlus reported that Maybank revised the 2 Gold and 2 Platinum terms from 6 January 2026. Earn rates did not change. The new wording says cashback and TreatsPoints on a refunded or reversed purchase can be taken back, in full or in part, even if the reward had not posted yet, and even if the reversal comes much later. This item is a press report. Confirm it against Maybank’s own terms before you rely on it.

changes.label: Refunds and reversals
changes.after: Rewards may be reversed on a full or partial refund, whenever it posts

notices.title: Ikhwan American Express miles rate in force since 22 May 2024
notices.summary: The Maybank Islamic Ikhwan Gold page still prints this notice: from 22 May 2024, Maybank American Express, Mastercard, and Visa Gold & Platinum convert at 20,000 TreatsPoints = 1,000 Enrich, KrisFlyer or Asia Miles, up from 14,000. It is an old change, and it is the rate the product page is still showing. Visa Infinite is a different table and is not this card.

changes.label: Air miles, Gold & Platinum including American Express

notices.title: Hong Leong credit-card terms revised from 14 May 2026
notices.summary: Notice dated 23 April 2026. Revised terms for Infinite P, Infinite, Infinite Doctor’s Edition and several other Hong Leong cards took effect on 14 May 2026. The news post links the new documents and does not itself spell a new earn rate — the May 2025 Enrich table is the rate change. Read the Infinite terms if a privilege you use is contractual.

notices.title: AmBank cardholder agreements revised from 30 September 2025
notices.summary: Notice dated 8 September 2025. The conventional and Islamic cardholder agreements, plus a long list of programme terms, took effect on 30 September 2025. The introduction does not itself publish a new miles rate — that is the April 2026 Enrich notice. This one is the contract refresh underneath both Visa Infinite cards.

notices.title: August 2025 features revision left Platinum Virtual alone
notices.summary: From 1 August 2025 Alliance rewrote Timeless Bonus Points and some annual fees on Visa Platinum and Visa Infinite. In the same notice Alliance said there are no changes to the features of the Visa Platinum Virtual Credit Card. If your virtual Visa is that product, this revision is a non-event. If it is a different virtual card, read the Infinite and Platinum tables before assuming you were spared.

notices.title: Alliance bonus points now expire after three years
notices.summary: Notice dated 10 November 2025, in force 1 December 2025. Timeless Bonus Points were renamed Three-year Bonus Points. The abbreviation stays TBP. Points no longer last forever: anything earned before 1 December 2025 expires on 30 November 2028, and points earned after that last until the end of the third year from the month they were earned. Enrich and AirAsia redemptions must be in blocks of 5,000 miles (75,000 TBP for 5,000 Enrich, 30,000 TBP for 5,000 AirAsia). The August 2025 features notice left Visa Platinum Virtual earn rates alone. This later notice is about the points balance itself. If your virtual Visa earns TBP, the expiry applies.

changes.label: Expiry
changes.after: Three years. Pre-December 2025 points expire 30 November 2028

changes.label: Air miles blocks
changes.after: Multiples of 5,000 Enrich or AirAsia points only

notices.title: Visa and Mastercard cardholder agreement revised
notices.summary: From 1 December 2025 the Alliance Bank Visa/Mastercard Credit Cardholder Agreement was revised under the Fair Treatment of Financial Consumers policy. It applies to Visa and Mastercard cardholders, which includes a virtual Visa. The notice points at the PDF rather than listing fee or points changes.

notices.title: Preferred Visa Infinite bonus thresholds rose — not your PETRONAS card
notices.summary: From 1 June 2026 the CIMB Preferred Visa Infinite extra-bonus campaign counts supplementary spend, and the monthly thresholds moved up: 25,000 bonus points from RM8,000 to RM10,000, and 35,000 bonus points from RM10,000 to RM12,000. You do not hold Preferred Visa Infinite. It is here so a CIMB points headline does not get mistaken for PETRONAS, Travel or the e Credit Card.
